production-possibilities-points.alt: A bowed-out production possibilities curve for a farm's corn and beans through points A to E, with point U inside (idle resources), point Z outside (unattainable now) and a dashed outward-shifted curve PPC2 (growth).

production-possibilities-shapes.alt: Three production possibilities curves side by side: bowed out (increasing opportunity cost), a straight line (constant opportunity cost) and, as a labeled contrast, bowed in (decreasing opportunity cost).
